audit.whatIsWrong: Two invented ability names that the packet's suspectName detector did not catch: 'E Golden Onslaught' (in early) and 'R Final Retribution' (in mid and whys[4]). Neither exists.
audit.why: Zaahen's E is Aureate Rush ('dashes to a location and slices around himself') and his R is Grim Deliverance ('rises then stabs downward, damaging enemies and healing for a portion of the damage dealt'). The packet only flagged "Let's Bounce" and "Unstable Matter's", both of which are false positives, so these two real errors would have shipped. The R error is compounded: the text calls Grim Deliverance a 'peel' that 'peels your dive', but Riot describes a self-centred damage-and-heal, not a displacement or disengage.
audit.corrected: E is Aureate Rush (dash plus a slice around himself); R is Grim Deliverance (damage plus a heal off it), not a peel.
sources: champ-data/_kits/zaahen.json (Aureate Rush E, Grim Deliverance R)

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in either layer mentions that BOTH champions in this matchup have a revive passive.
audit.why: Cultivation of War (P): 'When filled with Determination, Zaahen gains increased Attack Damage and can revive.' Cell Division (P) revives Zac off surviving bloblets on a 5 minute cooldown. So a trade that looks lethal for either side may not be, and the all-in maths in this lane are unlike any other matchup Zac plays. Crucially his revive is gated on Determination stacks he earns by hitting Zac with attacks and abilities — so refusing chip trades delays it.
audit.corrected: Both of you revive: his off full Determination stacks he earns by hitting you, yours off bloblets on a 5 minute cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.' The full layer compounds it by tracking a placeholder called 'Ultimate' rather than a named ability.
audit.why: The Darkin Glaive (Q) is 10s at rank 1, and the knock-up is on the RECAST, not the first cast — 'Zaahen can recast this ability to have his next attack deal bonus damage and knock up his target.' So the first glaive hit is the warning and the recast is the punish. Aureate Rush (E) is 10s, Dreaded Return (W) is 14s, Grim Deliverance (R) is 110s at rank 1. The level-2 all-in the content layer warns about is Q into E on two 10s cooldowns — that is the actual clock.
audit.corrected: His Q is 10s and the knock-up only comes on the recast; E is 10s, W 14s, R 110s at rank 1.
sources: champ-data/_kits/zaahen.json (all cooldowns and The Darkin Glaive recast text)

audit.whatIsWrong: Both sides carry displacement and neither layer says who wins the race.
audit.why: _missing-interactions.json flags knockup-enabler for this pairing: Zac's Stretching Strikes (Q) and Elastic Slingshot (E) against Zaahen's Darkin Glaive recast (Q) and Dreaded Return (W) pull. Whoever lands displacement first owns the trade, and Zac's E is a charged leap with a visible wind-up while Zaahen's W is a 850-range line — so Zac charging E in the open loses that race.
audit.corrected: Both of you displace. Charge E from fog or behind terrain, because his W pull at 850 range beats a telegraphed charge.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds is never mentioned, and the full layer even omits the anti-heal clause it includes for other matchups.
audit.why: _missing-interactions.json flags needs-antiheal on The Darkin Glaive (Q) and Grim Deliverance (R), and resistances-invalidated on Aureate Rush (E) — his E carries percent-health damage, so stacking raw HP against him is a worse answer than it looks for a Heartsteel Zac.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds matters here, and his E deals percent health — resistances beat raw HP stacking against it.

notes: BIGGEST SAMPLE IN THIS SLICE (805 games) AND THE WORST WIN RATE (43.23%), so I put the most work here. Two REAL ability-name errors that the packet's detector missed entirely: 'E Golden Onslaught' should be Aureate Rush, and 'R Final Retribution' should be Grim Deliverance (appearing in early, mid and whys[4]). The R error also carried a functional mistake — the text called it a peel that 'peels your dive', but Riot describes a self-centred damage-and-heal with no displacement. Worth checking whether the same two invented names appear in other champions' Zaahen entries, since they read like they came from one bad source rather than one bad guess. Both packet suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES ("Let's Bounce" missing its '!', and "Unstable Matter's" being flagged for the possessive). GENERATOR BUG: CHAMP_FULL.zac.zaahen.focus is the literal placeholder {text:'Zaahen Ultimate', letters:['R']}, so the whole full layer said 'track Ultimate'; I retargeted the strings I could reach to The Darkin Glaive, but dosFull and report still say 'Ultimate' because their array-of-objects shape has no documented before/after path form. NOT VERIFIED and left alone: whether Zaahen's revive can be denied by Grievous Wounds or by a killing blow of a specific type, and whether Dreaded Return's pull interrupts Zac's E charge.
